blocks.heading: What Still Needs NEET
rows: MBBS and BDS
Yes
NEET UG scores are the only route. NTA sets a qualifying line (213 marks general, 177 reserved in 2026) and counselling ranks decide the seat.
No "no-NEET" version exists, whatever a college ad says. Private and deemed seats still ask for a qualifying NEET score.
BAMS, BHMS, BUMS, BSMS
Yes
The AYUSH regulators keep NEET UG mandatory. For BAMS, NCISM dropped the 50% PCB marks rule from 2025 but kept NEET (Medical Dialogues, July 2025).
Counselling runs through AACCC for the all-India quota and state bodies for the rest.
BVSc and AH (veterinary)
Yes
Listed with the NEET-linked courses in the 2026 seat matrix: about 5,300 seats in 58 or more colleges.
A small pool. Read the veterinary page before you treat it as a fallback.
BSc Nursing
Depends on the state

Andhra Pradesh: applicants must have appeared in NEET UG 2026 and hold 45% in science (40% reserved) under the Dr NTR University notification. Maharashtra ran its own nursing CET on 6 and 7 May 2026 with 45% in PCB. The Military Nursing Service needs NEET.
The single most misreported course. Check your own state health university, not a national list.
BPT and BOT (physiotherapy, occupational therapy)
Not for 2026-27, yes from 2027-28
The allied-health commission deferred NEET for these two to 2027-28. For this cycle, admission uses Class 12 PCB marks: 50% general, 40% reserved, English compulsory, age 17 by 31 December 2026.
If you finish Class 12 in 2027, plan as if NEET will apply. The window is closing.
Optometry, dietetics, radiology, dialysis, OT and anaesthesia technology, applied psychology
Reported yes from 2026-27

Careers360 (12 March 2026) lists ten allied programmes that stay NEET-linked from 2026-27 after the BPT and BOT deferral. The commission site was not reachable for this check, so treat the list as reported.
Confirm with the admitting university before you count any of these as NEET-free.

blocks.heading: What Each NEET Score Band Opens
rows: 600 marks or more
About 10,160 candidates (NTA)

Government MBBS in most states and through the all-India quota. Karnataka round 1 closing ranks included 1,299 (Bangalore Medical College), 3,558 (Kasturba Medical College, Mangalore) and 4,053 (Mysore Medical College).
Government tuition roughly Rs 3 to 8 lakh over the course, less in some states.
500 to 599 marks
Up to 90,780 candidates at 500 or more

Government BDS sits one tier below government MBBS in competitiveness (PW Live's ranking, not an official cutoff). Government BAMS closed near rank 30,130 for general candidates in 2024. Government BHMS closed at reported ranks of 46,875 to 88,629 in an all-India round. Delhi government BSc Nursing closed between ranks 25,251 and 62,205 in 2025.
Government fees for BAMS run Rs 10,000 to Rs 2.5 lakh over five years.
400 to 499 marks
About 2.7 lakh candidates at 400 or more
Government BUMS closed near rank 1,37,386 in 2024. Most government AYUSH and dental seats are gone; private BDS, BAMS and BHMS seats open up.
Private BAMS runs Rs 10 to 50 lakh in total; the average listed is about Rs 10 lakh.
300 to 399 marks
Roughly rank 2.7 to 6 lakh
Private and deemed MBBS seats closed between 295 and 335 marks in earlier years, and private BDS, AYUSH and state-run nursing seats.
Management-quota MBBS: Rs 55 lakh to Rs 1.35 crore in tuition, about 17 to 18 times the government range.
213 to 299 marks (general)
Qualified, but up to rank 11.21 lakh
You hold the qualifying line for NEET-linked courses. Seats here are private, expensive and often unfilled, so compare them against NEET-free routes before you pay.
Ask for the full-course fee in writing, including hostel and deposits.
Below 213 (general) or 177 (reserved)
About 8.8 lakh of 20 lakh test-takers
No NEET-linked seat this year. The NEET-free routes are the whole game, and a repeat attempt is one option among several.
NEET-free routes below start at government-college fees.

blocks.heading: Exits for Every Stream
rows: CLAT UG (5-year law at NLUs)
Any stream
Applications close 31 October 2026; exam 6 December 2026
About 72,631 appeared in 2026, roughly 20 for every regular seat.
NID DAT (B.Des)
Any stream
Registration to 30 November 2026; prelims 20 December 2026
A drawing and portfolio test, not a marks test.
NIFT B.Des and UCEED (B.Des at IITs)
Any stream
NIFT stage 1 on 10 January 2027; UCEED reported for 17 January 2027
NIFT B.FTech needs Physics and Maths, so it is not a biology exit.
JEE Main (B.E. and B.Tech)
Needs Maths, so PCMB
Session 1 tentatively 22 to 24 and 28 to 30 January 2027
If you kept Maths alive next to Biology, this door never closed.
CUET UG (BA, BSc, BCom in central and many state universities)
Any stream
The 2026 round had 15.68 lakh registered; the 2027 round follows the same pattern
Biology and related subjects drew 5.56 lakh registrations, physics 9.14 lakh and chemistry 9.51 lakh.
NDA (Army wing)
Any stream for the Army wing
UPSC calendar lists applications to 22 December 2026 and the exam on 11 April 2027
The written exam has a 300-mark Maths paper.

blocks.heading: What the Numbers Say
rows: Staff nurse (private sector)
Rs 3,07,703 (278 profiles, February 2026)
Entry Rs 2,29,674
AIIMS Level 7 basic of Rs 44,900 a month is Rs 5,38,800 a year, 1.75 times this average and 2.35 times entry pay.
Pharmacist
Rs 3,00,140 (371 profiles)
Entry Rs 2,51,181
A wide gap between manufacturing and retail. Regulatory and quality roles sit in the upper range.
Medical laboratory technician
Rs 2,97,205 (274 profiles)
Entry Rs 2,33,492
The 90th percentile is Rs 9.27 lakh, so pay depends on the lab, city and specialisation.
Physiotherapist
Rs 3,20,000 (201 profiles, July 2026)
Entry Rs 2,92,986
The highest entry figure of the four, and the one with a real private practice path.

blocks.heading: High-Value Skill Stack for Each Path
rows: Pharmacy
Pharmaceutics, quality and regulatory documentation
Data handling in Excel or basic SQL, clear technical writing
A quality-audit checklist or a regulatory-filing case note built during an internship
Nursing and allied health
Procedure skill and accurate clinical records
A specialty such as critical care, plus communication with families and patient education
A logbook of supervised procedures and a short patient-education handout you wrote
Physiotherapy and dietetics
Assessment and a recovery or nutrition plan a patient follows
Client communication and a clear scope of practice; private practice needs trust, not only a certificate
Anonymised case notes with before-and-after outcomes
Life sciences, biotech, psychology
Lab method, experiment design or supervised assessment
Data analysis and science writing
A small research project or literature brief with your own analysis
Agriculture, food and dairy technology
Process control, food safety and quality testing
Costing, supplier handling and basic sales
A plant or farm internship report with one measured improvement

blocks.heading: What Shrinks and What Holds
rows: Lab technology and diagnostics
Routine report drafting and result sorting speed up with software.
Sample handling, quality checks, machine calibration and sign-off by a trained person.
Pharmacy
Routine counter tasks and stock records move to software.
Regulatory filing, quality assurance, drug-interaction judgment and licensed dispensing.
Nursing and physiotherapy
Charting and scheduling get lighter with digital tools.
Patient handling, bedside judgment, rehab progress and trust, which tools do not replace.
Agriculture and food technology
Basic yield forecasting and record keeping become tool tasks.
Field decisions, process control, food safety and running a plant or an advisory practice.

items.text: "I got 300 marks in NEET.
"Is NEET compulsory for BSc Nursing?"
"I am scoring 450 and my parents want me to take a BUMS seat.
"What should I do if my NEET is not qualifying?"
Paying an "admission guarantee" broker for a NEET-linked seat in a college that cannot show its regulator notification.
Taking a private nursing or pharmacy seat because the brochure says "no NEET" without checking your state rule and the college placement denominator.
Taking a drop year for BPT or BOT when this year is the last cycle on Class 12 marks.
Choosing a B.Pharm college by hostel photos in a state where a third of seats sat unfilled.
Treating a Rs 6 to 10 lakh salary claim as a normal first offer when the sample says about Rs 2.3 to 2.5 lakh.
Ignoring state domicile rules: Andhra Pradesh keeps 85% of its NEET-linked nursing seats for local candidates.
Which notification number does this course admit under.
How many students were in the last batch, and how many were placed.
What is the full fee, including hostel and deposits.
What is the fallback if the first plan fails.
If you already gave NEET and are choosing what to do next, read career options after NEET .
